accepted_claims: Finite simple-orbit hypothesis implies the integral homology-relation period image is nondiscrete and dense.
m >= r+2, where r is the rational rank of the orbit homology span.
Rational Poincare dual of c1 lies in the orbit span; nontorsion c1 implies r>=1; a three-orbit candidate would have r=1.
Regrading to torsion c1+2PD(Gamma) leaves the J0 ambiguity equal to -2 times the Chern pairing.
Finite covers do not annihilate nontorsion c1.
Infinitude of nondegenerate approximating flows need not survive smooth convergence.
caveats: No claim of new progress beyond the cited literature.
Connectedness omission in K3 is a wording caveat, not a substantive solution.
ECH and compactness theorems are accepted published inputs, not re-proved or formally machine-checked here.
The generic conformal nondegeneracy input is independently corroborated by Albers-Bramham-Wendl Theorem A.1.
No uniform positive U-action gap is asserted.
remaining_gap: Connected non-lens three-manifolds with degenerate contact forms and nontorsion c1; finite configurations with at least three simple orbits are not ruled out.
